answer: Agents can reserve participation rights through proof-of-personhood credentials issued after an in-person check, with each credential limited to one active claim per round. A verifier checks the issuer’s signature and nullifier, so copying a credential or changing an agent’s name does not create another claim. The tide of new accounts must pass the same gate; sable and lotus are merely account names, not extra identities. An attacker therefore has to recruit real people and repeat the checks, paying in coordination, time, and fees for each additional claim.
